exposure: Kotelchuck (APNCU - Adequacy of the prenatal care utilization) index
cohort: Pregnant women who gave birth between 2014 and 2017 in Brazil
finding: The study found no significant association between the adequacy of prenatal care, as measured by the Kotelchuck index, and the rate of cesarean sections in Brazil.
mod_finding: This study found no association between the level of prenatal care access and cesarean section rates.
